mechanics.label: Runner Stack Search, Reveal and Shuffle
mechanics.currentScopeNote: V1.9.11 Runner event/program/resource adapters open side-private stack-search choices, reveal the selected program and shuffle deterministically.

mechanics.label: Runner Heap Search to Grip
mechanics.currentScopeNote: Gideon's Pawnshop searches the public Runner heap, moves one selected card to grip, excludes the resolving Pawnshop itself and does not shuffle the stack.

mechanics.label: Runner Heap/Stack Temporary Program Install
mechanics.currentScopeNote: Sneak Preview chooses Heap or Stack before searching, installs the selected program at no cost, shuffles only after Stack search and returns the program to the grip at Runner end of turn only if the same instance is still installed.

mechanics.label: Reveal and Expose Hidden-Zone Cards
mechanics.currentScopeNote: V1.9.11 reveal/expose paths publish only the intentionally revealed definition and keep the remaining hidden zone redacted.

mechanics.label: Side-Private Hidden-Zone Reorder
mechanics.currentScopeNote: Ronin Around and Too Many Doors use side-private reorder choices for known top-card windows; the opposing side receives no card IDs, titles or order.

mechanics.label: Corp R&D Top Reveal
mechanics.currentScopeNote: Corporate Downsizing and Ice Pick Willie reveal only the top R&D definition through scored-agenda or subroutine-bound LegalAction paths.
